rationale: Its own Boolean function. Design-collapsed into nothing: IN_E2 is the only node in its design class, because e2_primed_maternal moves it alone. What it lacks is a shared readout, not separability -- basal_maternal reads S_IGFBP1 and e2_primed_maternal reads E_PAEP, so the contrast is set_alone_no_shared_readout.
what_would_change_it: Attaching a common readout to the two arms; that is an experimental change, not a rule change.

rationale: Its own Boolean function. Merged with IN_cAMP, IN_XAV939 and S_PKA by the DESIGN only: the cocktail moves the four agents together, so no arm attributes an effect to progestin alone. SOFIA-HT-001 warns explicitly against collapsing the four agents into progesterone without an explicit abstraction, and the rules do not -- the arms do.
what_would_change_it: A cocktail-dropout arm. docs/design_alias/candidate_fifth_arms.tsv scores minus-E2 and minus-cAMP; neither has a committed cfg.

rationale: REOPENED AND RE-ADJUDICATED 2026-09-16. This row previously read BIOLOGICALLY_COLLAPSED, and its own what_would_change_it named 'evidence that a cAMP effector other than PKA carries part of the decidual response'. That condition is now MET by primary human evidence. Kusama et al. (human primary endometrial stromal cells) report that the EPAC-selective cAMP analogue 8-CPT-2-OMe-cAMP ALONE has no effect on IGFBP-1, PRL or FOXO1, that it POTENTIATES the PKA-selective analogue N6-Phe-cAMP and activates RAP1, and that knockdown of EPAC1, EPAC2 or RAP1 INHIBITS the PKA-driven IGFBP-1 and PRL response. So cAMP drives at least two intracellular effectors and the second CONTRIBUTES TO the decidual response. The strongest statement the experiment supports is that EPAC/RAP1 potentiates the PKA arm and that knockdown attenuates it -- enough to falsify the exact identity cAMP = PKA, NOT enough to establish an independently sufficient Boolean gate. Collapsing the cAMP input onto PKA asserts that PKA is cAMP's only effector, which this contradicts, and it makes a PKA-selective and an EPAC-selective cAMP analogue -- two real, available, distinct interventions -- one intervention in the model. NO REPLACEMENT NODE IS PROPOSED: S_EPAC_RAP1 as a pass-through is measured inert (35 -> 35) and merely enlarges this class to three, and the evidence describes a COOPERATIVE requirement rather than an independent arm, so the disjunctive form is positively wrong. Acknowledging that the equivalence is false does not require knowing the right replacement. NOTE this verdict was reached from primary literature, NOT from the drug-target catalog: neither IN_cAMP nor S_PKA is a catalogued target, so the catalog-derived invariant could never have found it.
what_would_change_it: ANSWERED, so this row no longer asks for it. Kusama 2013 full text (PDF-045) reports knockdown 'SIGNIFICANTLY INHIBITED' the PKA-driven response -- ATTENUATION, not abolition -- and the EPAC-selective analogue alone was inert. That settles the Boolean-form question NEGATIVELY: the arm is a graded potentiator and a rate-free Boolean model cannot express potentiation, so no EPAC node is admissible on this evidence however the verdict moves. WHAT WOULD CHANGE THE VERDICT is different: evidence that cAMP's effect on the decidual response is carried by PKA ALONE, which would restore the identity. WHAT WOULD CHANGE THE REPRESENTATION is a declared relative-rate or graded layer in the formalism, at which point the potentiation becomes expressible and this should be revisited.

rationale: Its own Boolean function, and a ZERO-DEGREE node: no rule in network.bnd reads IN_XAV939, so the simulated hormone response contains no XAV939 contribution at all. It is design-merged into the cocktail class, but even de-bundling it would move nothing until a rule reads it.
what_would_change_it: A curated WNT/tankyrase edge. Until one exists, de-bundling XAV939 experimentally buys nothing.

rationale: Its own Boolean function and its own design class. The one input the recorded design perturbs independently AND reads on a shared outcome, both of its arms reporting OUT_STABLE_ADHESION.
what_would_change_it: Nothing pending. Note its direction was constructed citing SOFIA-HT-002, so only the magnitude is held out.

rationale: Its own Boolean function. Design-merged with five never-excited inputs because no recorded arm moves it. The planned fourth arm moves it alone, and neither anti-SPP1 cfg carries a recorded observation, so the plan isolates an input the design cannot read.
what_would_change_it: Attaching a readout to an anti-SPP1 arm. Running the arm without one leaves the perturbation unreadable.

rationale: Its own Boolean function. Design-merged with IN_TROPHECTODERM_COMPETENT, IN_EMBRYO_CONTACT and E_CDH1_APICAL because the embryo challenge moves three inputs at once, which is a protocol property and not a rule one.
what_would_change_it: An arm that presents an embryo without contact, or an incompetent one. embryo_absent.cfg and embryo_incompetent.cfg exist and carry no recorded observation.

rationale: Its own Boolean function; design-merged into the embryo-challenge bundle for the same reason as IN_EMBRYO_PRESENT.
what_would_change_it: The same de-bundled challenge arms.

rationale: Rule-merged with E_CDH1_APICAL, whose logic is literally IN_EMBRYO_CONTACT. LIT-CDH1-001 records apical CDH1 as supporting first contact AFTER embryo-conditioned induction, and requires apical adhesive CDH1 to stay distinct from lateral-junction CDH1. The rule encodes no induction step at all, so contact and the epithelial response to contact are one variable. IN_EMBRYO_CONDITIONED_SIGNAL is declared as an input and is read by no rule, so the inducer the evidence names is present in the model and unused.
what_would_change_it: An induction rule making E_CDH1_APICAL a function of IN_EMBRYO_CONDITIONED_SIGNAL or IN_HCG as well as contact. This is curation and not invention: the repair is ALREADY CATALOGUED, as the cdh1 family's maternal_receptive_state_dependent and maternal_priming_with_contact_reinforcement variants -- but only for adoc-literature-v0.2.0. The v0.4.0 superset declares no runtime rule-variant families at all, so the alternative cannot currently be executed against the model that carries the defect.

rationale: Its own Boolean function, and a ZERO-DEGREE node: no rule reads IN_HCG, and it is false in all 20 protocols. LIT-CD98-001 names hCG as an inducer of CD98/CD9, which makes its absence from every rule a gap rather than an economy.
what_would_change_it: Wiring hCG into E_CD98_CD9, which is the same repair E_CD98_CD9's own row asks for.

rationale: Its own Boolean function, and a ZERO-DEGREE node: no rule reads it. LIT-CDH1-001 and LIT-CD98-001 both name embryo-conditioned induction as the trigger for the epithelial adhesive response, and neither is wired.
what_would_change_it: The induction rules named in E_CDH1_APICAL and E_CD98_CD9. The CDH1 one is already catalogued as a v0.2.0 rule variant; the CD98 one is not catalogued anywhere.

rationale: Its own Boolean function and read by S_HAND2, so unlike the other never-excited inputs it would move something. The design-alias scoring makes HAND2 loss the largest single class gain available (+5, 19 to 24) and it separates no two measured analytes.
what_would_change_it: An arm that sets it. Two committed cfgs already exist and carry no recorded observation.

rationale: Its own Boolean function. Never TRUE in any of the six recorded arms, so within the recorded design it cannot move a readout even though it is wired into X_MECHANICAL_PERMISSIVE_ECM.
what_would_change_it: Recording an observation on excess_er_stress.cfg, which exists and carries none.

rationale: Its own Boolean function; same position as IN_ER_STRESS_EXCESS, never TRUE in a recorded arm.
what_would_change_it: Recording an observation on high_ecm_stiffness.cfg.

rationale: Rule-merged with S_PGR, E_IHH, S_NR2F2 and S_BMP2 -- all five reduce to IN_PROGESTIN and not IN_MIFEPRISTONE. For E_PGR against S_PGR specifically the merge is an information limit and not a contradiction: no assay in this repository reads receptor state in either compartment, and no perturbation moves one without the other, so nothing establishes that epithelial and stromal PGR differ. It is recorded as unidentified rather than defensible because the model ASSERTS the identity, which is stronger than the evidence.
what_would_change_it: A compartment-resolved PGR readout, or a perturbation reaching one compartment only. The scRNA object now held could speak to the first.

rationale: E_IHH = E_PGR, and S_NR2F2 = E_IHH and S_PGR, and S_PGR = E_PGR. The epithelium-to-stroma IHH relay therefore carries no information: every node on it is the same function of progestin. LIT-IHH-001 records the relay as the mechanism by which epithelial PGR drives stromal decidualization, and the encoding makes that channel vacuous. The repository already states the consequence in docs/results_reproducibility_matrix.md: S_DECIDUALIZED has no epithelial input that survives absorption, so the model has no working epithelium-to-stroma channel at all.
what_would_change_it: An intermediate on the IHH branch, or any rule that makes stromal state depend on an epithelial variable that is not itself a function of progestin.

rationale: The hub of the nine-member class: eight nodes reduce to it, so the adjudication of this class is carried by those eight rows, not by this one. As the program itself (IN_E2 and E_PGR) it is the intended abstraction -- SOFIA-SC-001 reports the HT epithelial program as a co-expressed set, which is what a single state represents. SEPARABILITY CHECKED 2026-09-16: E_SECRETORY_STATE is not an entry in drug_target_catalog.tsv, so no perturbation this repository declares is lost by collapsing onto it. The six catalogued targets that ARE in this class are adjudicated ARTIFICIALLY_COUPLED on their own rows.
what_would_change_it: Nothing about this node. Every candidate repair in this class is about which members should leave it.

rationale: PAEP is the canonical secreted marker of the receptive epithelial program and SOFIA-EPI-001/002 measure it as exactly that. Treating the marker as the program is the abstraction the evidence supports. Recorded with a caveat rather than without one: E_PAEP is one of only two measured nodes and OM-001 is the sole active calibration constraint, so the other eight members of this class are calibrated through it and inherit its fit. SEPARABILITY CHECKED 2026-09-16: PAEP is a secreted READOUT, not an entry in drug_target_catalog.tsv, so this merge costs no perturbation distinction. What it does cost is a readout distinction, and that is recorded against OUT_EPITHELIAL_RECEPTIVE rather than here.
what_would_change_it: A second measured epithelial analyte that moves apart from PAEP. The design-alias scoring finds none among the 112 candidates that splits this class internally.

rationale: Its own Boolean function and its own design class, and the only one of the five hand-set free variables that scRNA can observe. The pre-registered attempt to supply its prior concluded that these data do not establish one; nothing was activated.
what_would_change_it: A reference population for high, or a KLF12 assay with dynamic range. Not more analysis of the 28,212 cells.

rationale: REVISED 2026-09-16 from BIOLOGICALLY_COLLAPSED after review. The earlier call treated E_LIF = E_GP130_STAT3 as one ligand and its immediate transducer, which is true and is not the test. drug_target_catalog.tsv lists E_LIF (target_class ligand), E_GP130_STAT3 (pathway_state) and E_CD98_CD9 (adhesive_effector) as THREE SEPARATE EXECUTABLE PERTURBATION TARGETS, and the rules make them one Boolean function. So LIF neutralisation and STAT3 inhibition -- two perturbations docs/v05_plan_review.md lists side by side on the same candidate axis, above the note that E_LIF and E_GP130_STAT3 are both present -- are the SAME intervention in this model. They are not the same experiment: STAT3 inhibition blocks the pathway whichever ligand drives it, LIF neutralisation does not, and X_IL11 is the staged candidate that makes the difference real rather than hypothetical. This is the repository's highest-value axis: four of the only six class-gaining readouts sit on it.
what_would_change_it: Giving E_GP130_STAT3 a rule that admits a second ligand -- IL11 is the named candidate and is staged, not canonical. Until then the axis cannot be ranked by perturbation, because its two named perturbations are one variable.

rationale: REVISED 2026-09-16 from BIOLOGICALLY_COLLAPSED after review; the pathway end of the same merge as E_LIF, and the end that matters for intervention, because a pathway state is what an inhibitor acts on. The catalog already draws the distinction the rules erase: it carries S_STAT3 as a separate (catalog_only) target, so the repository distinguishes epithelial from stromal STAT3 while the executable model cannot distinguish epithelial STAT3 from the ligand upstream of it.
what_would_change_it: A ligand-independent route into E_GP130_STAT3, or any rule that lets the pathway state differ from E_LIF. See E_LIF.

rationale: Its own Boolean function and its own design class. The one epithelial node whose value depends on a stromal variable (S_FGF_MITOGENIC, S_HAND2), so it is the model's only surviving stroma-to-epithelium channel.
what_would_change_it: Nothing pending.

rationale: Rule-merged with E_DAG1_FULL and E_MUC1_BARRIER, all three reducing to not E_SECRETORY_STATE, so X_ANTIADHESIVE_ROUTE's three-way disjunction collapses to one variable. LIT-BARRIER-001 treats the three as one behavioural class -- antiadhesive maternal barrier mechanisms -- so the merge is not contradicted. It is recorded as unidentified and deliberately NOT as artificial: whether reconnecting these to attachment or retention is evidence-supported, and whether it changes any intervention, is the question Gate 3b is to answer, and prejudging it here would settle by adjudication what the plan asks to settle by analysis.
what_would_change_it: A barrier-specific perturbation or readout that moves one of the three without the others, plus the per-relay ambiguity decomposition Gate 3b opens with.

rationale: REVISED 2026-09-16 from BIOLOGICALLY_COLLAPSED after review. The earlier call checked whether PC6's FUNCTION was encoded -- it is, as E_DAG1_FULL = not E_PC6 -- and not whether PC6 could be PERTURBED apart from the program. It cannot: E_PC6 is rule-identical to E_SECRETORY_STATE, so setting the protease off means abolishing the whole secretory program. drug_target_catalog.tsv lists E_PC6 with target_class protease, alongside five other executable targets in the same Boolean function that it types differently, and LIT-PC6-001 names PC6 ACTIVITY as the barrier-release step -- an enzymatic step, which is the shape of thing an agent acts on.
what_would_change_it: A rule that lets convertase activity differ from the secretory program -- post-translational regulation is the obvious candidate and is not curated here.

rationale: The class hub; same adjudication and the same reason as E_PODXL, and the same Gate 3b dependency.
what_would_change_it: See E_PODXL.

rationale: REVISED 2026-09-16 from BIOLOGICALLY_COLLAPSED after review. Identity between a protease and its product remains a defensible one-step abstraction on its own terms, and that is not the binding question: the catalog types E_DAG1_CLEAVED as adhesive_surface_release and E_PC6 as protease, two executable targets, and puts both in one Boolean function together with an integrin, a growth factor, a glycoform and a cytoskeletal effector. No perturbation in this model can reach the released surface without reaching all of them.
what_would_change_it: Any repair that gives one member of the nine-node secretory class a rule of its own; the class is adjudicated as a whole under E_ITGAVB3_5 and E_PC6.

rationale: Same class and same adjudication as E_PODXL. LIT-BARRIER-001 additionally requires MUC1 to be given dual-state treatment because abundance and glycoform can reverse the interpretation, and the model does give it two nodes -- but as exact logical complements (E_MUC1_BARRIER = not E_SECRETORY_STATE, E_MUC1_SLEX = E_SECRETORY_STATE), so the two states can never be observed apart or be both off.
what_would_change_it: A glycoform-resolved MUC1 readout, which would also test whether the forced complementarity holds.

rationale: REVISED 2026-09-16 from BIOLOGICALLY_COLLAPSED after review. LIT-BARRIER-001's dual-state requirement for MUC1 is met in name and not in substance: E_MUC1_SLEX and E_MUC1_BARRIER are exact logical complements, and E_MUC1_SLEX is additionally rule-identical to a protease, an integrin, a growth factor and a cytoskeletal effector that the catalog types as five different executable targets. A glycoform-directed perturbation is therefore indistinguishable from an integrin blockade here.
what_would_change_it: A rule that lets the permissive glycoform differ from the secretory program, which would also test the forced complementarity with E_MUC1_BARRIER.

rationale: REVISED 2026-09-16 from UNIDENTIFIED after review. LIT-HBEGF-001 declining to assert a strong Boolean direction was read as licence to leave the merge unadjudicated; it is not, because the question is what the model can EXPRESS rather than what the literature asserts. drug_target_catalog.tsv carries E_HBEGF as an executable target of class growth_factor_effector inside a Boolean function that also holds a protease, an integrin, a glycoform, a cytoskeletal effector and a surface-release state. An HB-EGF neutralisation and an integrin blockade are one intervention in this model.
what_would_change_it: A rule separating HB-EGF from the secretory program. None of the 112 scored candidate arms separates it by design, so this is a model repair and not an experiment.

rationale: Rule-identical to the secretory program, so epithelial SPP1 expression cannot be distinguished from PAEP. The modularity LIT-SPP1-001 asks for is nevertheless preserved downstream, because IN_ANTI_SPP1 acts on X_SPP1_LUMEN_FREE rather than on expression, so anti-SPP1 neutralises free ligand without erasing competence. The merge is an information limit, not a foreclosed intervention.
what_would_change_it: An epithelial SPP1 readout that moves apart from PAEP, or evidence that expression rather than free ligand is the intervention target.

rationale: The integrin is the RECEPTOR of the SPP1 route, and it is rule-identical to the whole secretory program. The consequence is checkable and is checked: in X_ADHESION_ROUTE_SPP1 = E_RECEPTIVE_SURFACE and X_SPP1_LUMEN_FREE and E_ITGAVB3_5 and X_INTERFACE_SPP1_RELAY, the E_ITGAVB3_5 conjunct is absorbed by E_RECEPTIVE_SURFACE over all 2^19 free-variable assignments, so it is vacuous. An integrin blockade is therefore unrepresentable in the model whose headline adhesion route is integrin-mediated, and the ADOC design never measured ITGB3, alphaVbeta3 or ITGB5, so nothing would have caught it. SECOND, INDEPENDENT GROUND added 2026-09-16: the catalog types E_ITGAVB3_5 adhesive_receptor and lists five further executable targets of five other classes in the same Boolean function, so even setting the absorption aside, no perturbation here can reach the integrin alone.
what_would_change_it: Giving the integrin a rule that is not implied by the receptive surface -- which is also what makes an integrin or SPP1-receptor perturbation rankable at all.

rationale: E_CD98_CD9 = E_GP130_STAT3, so CD98/CD9 availability is asserted to be a function of LIF. CORRECTED 2026-09-16 against the primary source. An earlier revision of this rationale said the encoding 'asserts an inducer the evidence does not name and omits the one it does'. That is WRONG and rested on the evidence register's one-line summary. Dominguez et al. 2010 (PLOS One, 'Human endometrial CD98 is essential for blastocyst adhesion') reports CD98 induced in primary human endometrial epithelial cells by hCG, 17-beta-estradiol, LIF OR EGF -- LIF IS among the named inducers. The defect is therefore INCOMPLETENESS, not misattribution: the evidence names four inducers and the rule encodes one, which is what makes CD98 availability identical to LIF-driven STAT3 activity and a CD98 knockdown indistinguishable from a STAT3 inhibition. IN_HCG is a declared input of this model and is read by NO rule. SECOND, INDEPENDENT GROUND added 2026-09-16: the catalog types E_CD98_CD9 adhesive_effector, E_GP130_STAT3 pathway_state and E_LIF ligand, three executable targets in one Boolean function, so the merge also destroys the distinction between a CD98/CD9-directed perturbation and a STAT3 inhibition.
what_would_change_it: Wiring E_CD98_CD9 to IN_HCG, which Dominguez 2010 names directly. NOT to IN_EMBRYO_CONDITIONED_SIGNAL: no primary source read here supports a generic embryo-conditioned inducer, and the structural probe cannot tell the two apart -- STAT3-or-hCG, STAT3-or-hCG-or-E2 and STAT3-or-generic-signal all give an identical 35 -> 36. The choice rests on evidence alone, and the evidence says hCG.

rationale: REVISED 2026-09-16 from UNIDENTIFIED after review. LIT-ANXA2-001 asks for ANXA2-RHOA-F-actin remodelling to be a positive support route or a rate modifier rather than a mandatory gate; the model instead makes it identical to the entire secretory program, which is the strongest possible form of gate. The catalog types it cytoskeletal_effector and lists it as executable alongside five differently typed executable targets in the same Boolean function. That the register's preferred representation (a rate) has no target in a rate-free model is a reason not to invent one, not a reason to leave the merge unadjudicated.
what_would_change_it: A rule separating cytoskeletal remodelling from the secretory program. A relative-rate layer would also serve, and must not be built for this node alone.

rationale: Its rule is literally IN_EMBRYO_CONTACT, so the epithelial response to contact and contact itself are one variable and no arm can ever separate them. LIT-CDH1-001 names an embryo-conditioned induction step between the two and requires apical CDH1 to remain distinct from lateral-junction CDH1; the rule encodes neither.
what_would_change_it: An induction rule making E_CDH1_APICAL a function of IN_EMBRYO_CONDITIONED_SIGNAL or IN_HCG as well as contact. This is curation and not invention: the repair is ALREADY CATALOGUED, as the cdh1 family's maternal_receptive_state_dependent and maternal_priming_with_contact_reinforcement variants -- but only for adoc-literature-v0.2.0. The v0.4.0 superset declares no runtime rule-variant families at all, so the alternative cannot currently be executed against the model that carries the defect.

rationale: The class hub and the model's one genuinely composite epithelial state -- a conjunction of GP130/STAT3 activation, three barrier states being off, proliferation being off, and any one of eight adhesive routes being on. The merge in this class is not caused by this node but by OUT_EPITHELIAL_RECEPTIVE's absorbed conjunct, adjudicated there. SEPARABILITY CHECKED 2026-09-16: a composite state, not an entry in drug_target_catalog.tsv, so no declared perturbation is made unreachable by the merge.
what_would_change_it: See OUT_EPITHELIAL_RECEPTIVE.

rationale: The stromal half of the receptor merge; same adjudication and the same reason as E_PGR.
what_would_change_it: See E_PGR.

rationale: REOPENED AND RE-ADJUDICATED 2026-09-16 together with IN_cAMP; see that row for the full basis. In short: Kusama et al. show in primary human endometrial stromal cells that cAMP acts through EPAC/RAP1 as well as PKA and that the decidual IGFBP-1 and PRL response requires both, so S_PKA cannot stand for the whole cAMP branch. No replacement node is proposed; the EPAC arm is cooperative rather than independent and its Boolean form is not yet decidable.
what_would_change_it: ANSWERED, so this row no longer asks for it. Kusama 2013 full text (PDF-045) reports knockdown 'SIGNIFICANTLY INHIBITED' the PKA-driven response -- ATTENUATION, not abolition -- and the EPAC-selective analogue alone was inert. That settles the Boolean-form question NEGATIVELY: the arm is a graded potentiator and a rate-free Boolean model cannot express potentiation, so no EPAC node is admissible on this evidence however the verdict moves. WHAT WOULD CHANGE THE VERDICT is different: evidence that cAMP's effect on the decidual response is carried by PKA ALONE, which would restore the identity. WHAT WOULD CHANGE THE REPRESENTATION is a declared relative-rate or graded layer in the formalism, at which point the potentiation becomes expressible and this should be revisited.

rationale: S_NR2F2 = E_IHH and S_PGR, and both reduce to the same function, so the stromal receiver of the IHH signal is identical to the stromal receptor and the channel transmits nothing. LIT-IHH-001 and SOFIA-CCC-001 both record NR2F2/COUP-TFII as the stromal target of epithelial IHH, which is precisely the distinction the encoding erases.
what_would_change_it: The same repair as E_IHH: an intermediate or a dependence that is not itself a function of progestin.

rationale: S_BMP2 = (S_PGR and S_PKA) or S_NR2F2 reduces to S_PGR, so BMP2 is identical to progestin receptor activity. BMP2 is the one stromal transcript the paper reports as HT-upregulated and the repository's own comparator for it (OM-010, via R21) cannot distinguish it from receptor state. The cAMP dependence in its own rule is absorbed and does nothing.
what_would_change_it: Breaking the IHH relay collapse, after which the cAMP conjunct in S_BMP2 stops being absorbed.

rationale: Its own Boolean function -- one of the few stromal nodes that is, because IN_HAND2_LOSS enters its rule and nothing else's. Design-merged into the large class only because no recorded arm sets IN_HAND2_LOSS.
what_would_change_it: An arm setting IN_HAND2_LOSS; two committed cfgs exist and carry no recorded observation.

rationale: Its own Boolean function (not S_HAND2), and the carrier of the model's only stroma-to-epithelium influence, through E_ESTROGENIC_PROLIFERATION.
what_would_change_it: Nothing pending.

rationale: The hub of the six-member class; the adjudication of this class is carried by its members. Recorded with the caveat LIT-DECID-001 states: decidualization is a balanced remodelling state with a senescence arm, and a single ON bit represents none of that. That is an abstraction limit of the node, not a merge with another node. SEPARABILITY CHECKED 2026-09-16: a composite state, not an entry in drug_target_catalog.tsv. The two catalogued targets in this class, S_SPP1 and S_TAZ_ECM, are adjudicated ARTIFICIALLY_COUPLED on their own rows.
what_would_change_it: A graded or two-armed decidual representation, which is a model-class question rather than a de-aliasing one.

rationale: S_PRL = S_IGFBP1 = S_DECIDUALIZED, with no rate declared anywhere, so the two analytes are synchronous by construction. ADOC's own ELISA contradicts that: at day 0 basal IGFBP-1 is detected in 4/5 units at 37.90-551.26 pg/mL while basal PRL is 0/6; at day 3 IGFBP-1 is 5/5 with four above 1000 pg/mL while PRL is 1/6 at a maximum of 113.60. The 2x difference in detection limits cannot manufacture a >25x day-0 gap. OM-016 records this as a falsifiable structural requirement and the current model fails it. Kane et al. 2010 independently dissociate the two in human endometrial stromal cells, by SMAD-dependent and SMAD-independent routes. THE STRONGEST ADJUDICATION IN THIS FILE, and the one Gate 3a repairs.
what_would_change_it: Rules that let IGFBP-1 precede PRL, with the ordering DEMONSTRATED by simulating the transient rather than inferred from topology. OM-016 is construction evidence for that repair, direction included, so its later agreement is a consistency check and never validation.

rationale: The other half of the PRL/IGFBP-1 identity; see S_PRL. Note it is additionally one of the model's only two measured nodes, so the coupling is load-bearing for calibration as well as for prediction.
what_would_change_it: See S_PRL.

rationale: REVISED 2026-09-16 from UNIDENTIFIED after review. S_SPP1 (catalog target_class decidual_effector) and S_TAZ_ECM (mechanical_regulator) are two executable drug-target entries sharing one Boolean function, so an SPP1-directed agent and a TAZ/YAP-directed one are the same intervention in this model although the catalog types them differently and they would be expected to move different things. The earlier call rested on decidual QUALITY being graded and unmeasured, which is true of the readout and says nothing about the target.
what_would_change_it: A rule separating stromal SPP1 from the decidual state. Note IN_ANTI_SPP1 already acts modularly at X_SPP1_LUMEN_FREE, so the free-ligand intervention is representable; it is the stromal SOURCE that is not.

rationale: REVISED 2026-09-16 from UNIDENTIFIED after review, and the revision turns on a distinction the earlier call blurred. The mechanical READOUTS -- displacement, spreading, alignment -- are adjudicated out of the Boolean formalism by results_reproducibility_matrix.tsv, and that is unaffected. The mechanical TARGET is not out of scope: a TAZ/WWTR1-directed agent's effect on attachment fraction is perfectly expressible, and the catalog lists S_TAZ_ECM as executable with target_class mechanical_regulator. Sharing one Boolean function with S_SPP1 (decidual_effector) therefore destroys a perturbation distinction the formalism could have carried. Separately, the S_TAZ_ECM conjunct in X_MECHANICAL_PERMISSIVE_ECM is absorbed in all 2^19 assignments, so the TAZ arm contributes nothing there either.
what_would_change_it: A rule separating TAZ/ECM remodelling from the decidual state. This is a MaBoSS question, not a PhysiBoSS one: the readout it would move is the attachment fraction.

rationale: Its own Boolean function and its own design class. Not a mechanism: logic = self makes it a Bernoulli coin flipped once at t=0 from a hand-typed istate (0.30). It gates only through IN_ER_STRESS_EXCESS and IN_HIGH_ECM_STIFFNESS, both FALSE in every recorded arm, so within the recorded design it cannot move any readout.
